translations.web: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
translations.bsb: May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.
translations.kjv: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
translations.asv: Let destruction come upon him unawares; And let his net that he hath hid catch himself: With destruction let him fall therein.
